title: Oscitancy
summary: OS'CITANCY, noun [Latin oscito, to yawn, from os, the mouth.] 1. The act of gaping or yawning. 2. Unusual sleepiness; drowsiness; dullness. It might proceed from the oscitancy of transcribers.
